artworks.title: Glauce and Thaleia
artworks.description: Laurens' Salon canvas pairs two Nereids — Glauce and Thaleia — as sea-sisters in quiet companionship, not the Muse Thalia of comedy. Apollodorus and Homer keep Thalia among Nereus' fifty daughters.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book XVIII — Thalia is named among Thetis' mourning Nereid companions when Achilles' mother rises from the sea.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus lists Thalia among the fifty Nereids — the sea-sister, not the Muse of comedy.

popCulture.title: Thalia (Nereid)
popCulture.description: Nereid daughter of Nereus and Doris — Homeric mourner with Thetis, distinct from Thalia the Muse.
